steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's no use! The road is blocked up ahead!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: They're coming from that direction as well. This isn't working. We aren't getting anywhere!

steps.name: Gang Member
steps.text: That's as far as you go!

steps.name: Gang Member
steps.text: Nowhere to run. Now hand them over!

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Dammit...

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: We can't let them take the Infected! Hold on, I'll take out the hostiles blocking the way upfront. Use the opportunity to break through them!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Hey, don't do it! Come back!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Calm down! This is no time to be a hero!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: That's right! You're injured!

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: But—!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: No buts. Ace will come back us up for sure! Don't panic!
—You got that right!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's her!

steps.name: Gang Member
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Gang Member
steps.text: Watch out! Argh, it's damn hot—

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Suddenly it's getting hotter in here. What's going on...? Hold on, what happened to the wall over there and the barricade... They got sliced apart?!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: That's our backup.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Feeling toasty? Sorry about that. It took me some work to cut these things apart. I might've overdone it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm still learning to control the heat. I'll try harder next time.

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: That chainsaw... You're with Ace—

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Thank goodness, it's Blaze!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Ha, fashionably late.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah, here I am!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sorry for keeping you all waiting. It took me a little longer than I expected to deal with the other bad guys. The teams will regroup here soon.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Okay, let's charge through them. Stick to the plan.

steps.name: Gang Member
steps.text: How is this even possible? Those barriers were made of some real special stuff! Did she seriously cut right through that?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sorry, buddy. Honestly, I didn't expect it to go that well myself. All I did was slicing from top to bottom—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Seriously, we don't have to fight to the death here, right? How about this? You leave my friends alone and let us take the Infected, and you guys get to go unharmed.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't want to hurt you if I don't have to.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What a meanie. Just lash out without saying a word? It's really not that hard to talk it out, is it?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Blaze, there's no talking to these guys. Get ready to break through!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Got it! Let me raise the temperature a bit more—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: One last thing. I'm really sorry this is how things turned out, and I mean this from the bottom of my heart.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: O-Owww...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ugh, my arm. Oww.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I used that technique I've been working on. I guess I pushed myself a little too far... Hurts so much I thought I broke my arm.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I guess the thrust's a little off? Did I miscalculate? But...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What are you doing here talking to yourself?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh... It's you, Weedy. You spooked me.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Well, you spooked me.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What's the matter? Am I not supposed to be here?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: N-No, that's not what I meant. It's just... I don't usually see you around this time.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's not often you step outside that workshop of yours when it's not lunch or dinnertime.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sometimes you don't even come out to eat, and I couldn't drag you out of there no matter how hard I try.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Don't exaggerate. I come outside for fresh air sometimes.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Also, if I ever see you in my lab with your outside shoes, I'll snatch your entrance permission.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: R-Right, I'll keep that in mind!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Also.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Also?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Could you at least... wear your clothes right? Look how messed up you got here.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh? My clothes? Where? Here?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What are you doing? Wait, stop pulling so hard. You're making it worse!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I can't take this... Stop! I'll fix it for you!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hehe, thanks.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're way too sensitive about this stuff, you know that? You even managed to get Closure to wash her hands after work. That's no easy feat...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, right, perfect timing. Weedy, you're good with the book studying stuff, right?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I do research... Does that count as studying?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yes, of course! Why wouldn't it count?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: See, there's something I wanted to ask you about...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Now that doesn't happen every day. Go ahead.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Uh, it's actually a question about gravitational acceleration. Also, I need a formula for figuring out parasitic drag and energy expansion. You have to know this stuff, right? Mind teaching me?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh? What's the matter? Why are you touching my forehead...?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Hm... Doesn't seem like you have a fever.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'm surprised to see you interested in this topic.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: How strange. I thought it was sunny today? Did it start raining all of a sudden?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Don't be like that. It's not that I'm into it, but I don't really have a choice here. This is actually useful.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whatever, just take a look at this.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What is it...? Have you been reading this?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: This is all advanced stuff, and the questions listed here...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Sorry, I take that back.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hm? Take what back?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You're actually studying hard. One cannot come up with these questions just by leafing through the book. I must apologize.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Eh? Hahaha, no need. Why so serious? I don't mind at all.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're not the only one who says stuff like that.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I mean, I'm really not all that smart. It takes a lot of work to learn this stuff, and researching on stuff like that is just not my thing.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: But you...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't have a choice. There are lots of things I wanna do, so I gotta get stronger, and I'll try anything that could help me get there.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hehe, I mean, this is just studying. It's so much easier than being Ace's punching bag on the training grounds, right?
Oh, so you talk about me behind my back like that?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Agh!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Well, I'm glad to see you so full of ginger, Blaze, but enough screwing around. You're being a bad influence on Weedy.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ace!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Hello, Ace.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm not being a bad influence on her. I'm just telling the truth!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: When you and Mechanist took me out for special training last time, I almost got sliced into two, right through my belly button!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Well, we were tuning your new weapon for you. Making it as destructive as you wanted it to be wasn't an easy thing. Mechanist spent days at his workbench just to get it done.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: You should've seen the sketches he shredded. He used so much paper, Logistics gave him an earful.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's not good.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But I really gotta thank him for giving me this big guy. It feels so natural while I'm slicing things up... And if it wasn't for this, I guess I wouldn't have been able to use that new technique of mine.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Look! I brought some Siracusan cheese back as souvenir. It has some really unique flavor, supposedly. I'll take some to Mechanist later.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: (Sniffs)

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Gross.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Haha, I can't say for sure he's going to like this...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Oh, right, Weedy.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: It's the application you filed with Engineering the other day. We got the materials from Closure already.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I was just about to ask...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: To be honest, I would never have thought we'd get a request like that.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: But if that's what you want, and Closure is willing to vouch for the things you make, who am I to say no?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: So, does that mean... I...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: You're a regular operator now.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Eh? What's going on? You want to go out into the field, Weedy?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Do you have a problem with that?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, no, of course not! I look forward to fighting with you. I'd never look down on you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's only that... well... Are you sure you can keep up?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I, too, want some change once in a while.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I may be weak, but I have certain areas I excel at. Though I may trail everyone else when it comes to physical capabilities, don't underestimate what my water cannons can do. They might just have more thrust than you do, Blaze.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sounds reliable enough to me! If we ever go out on a mission together, I'm counting on you to have my back!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'll think about it...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Ahem, so do you still need me to help you with those questions? If so, bring them over tonight, and I'll take a look.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I should get going now.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hm? What? Is she... shy?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: You should try not to say that in front of her.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course I won't. I've got manners.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hm... I should go back to get my mission logs in order. I had to use my new technique when things got desperate, but it feels like something was still missing.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The feel? No, it's probably a numbers problem...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: So that's why you checked out these advanced textbooks? I know you're not fond of formulas and numbers.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course I don't like them, and I've been tearing my hair out over them!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But I don't have a choice! My Arts aren't the kind you can just throw all over the place without thinking. If I want to do my job well, I have to work harder.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Haha, oh yeah? That's great. A load off my shoulders.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Right, Mechanist is working on improvements too. Be sure to talk to him. He'll take a look.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No problem. I'll go check on him right away! And even if he keeps me knocking on his door for hours again, I'm not going to complain.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: I doubt he'll put you through that. You'll get to see him pretty soon.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Has Dr. Kal'tsit talked to you about that yet?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh... That?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, I heard you needed me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What's the matter? You seem pretty solemn. Is it something important?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes, I think this is very important indeed, both for you and Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well, crap. You talking like that is making me a little nervous.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Blaze, how long has it been since you came on board?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hm... Let me see... Almost a year.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Time flies.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Time leaves us all behind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your growth in the past year has been apparent to all of us. Even if it wasn't your intention to prove anything with your actions, you have indeed shown us what you are capable of.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ace and many other operators all think very highly of you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why are we talking about this all of a sudden? I'm starting to blush...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your body temperature is normal.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm doing what I can to hold it back here!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I suppose you already know what I summoned you for.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I have my guesses...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Very well. I'll get to the point.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ever since Rhodes Island was established, we've had many members come and go. I won't say much about that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We welcome those who share our ideology, but, of course, ideologies are not to be imposed on anyone.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That said... We need members who can walk this journey with us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Blaze, it's natural if you aren't ready, and none of us will force you to do anything.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But if you are ready...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Come to the lower deck of the bridge and open the door to the left of the stairs. We will be waiting for you there.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's what she said...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ace, do you know what Dr. Kal'tsit was talking about?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: You really need me to tell you? I thought you said you had your guesses?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I do, but... I don't know for sure.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There are only so many things that Dr. Kal'tsit would talk to me about, especially all formally like that.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So I guess maybe she's giving me a chance to do what you do?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: More or less. Looks like you know the score.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm not stupid.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well, how should I put this? It's like a dream. It doesn't feel real.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Like, I've never thought of myself as stronger than anyone else here. I still have a ways to go to match any of you.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Blaze, you—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, Blaze, there you are!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've been looking for you!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hm? Oh, it's the little rabbit!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're looking for me? Hey, careful. Don't trip... Look how bouncy you are! You're just a delight!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Eh? B-Blaze, stahp squishing mah face!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Come on. What's the harm?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: (Looks like I needn't say anything then...)

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: (Amiya, I'm leaving her to you.)

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Well then, I'll see you later.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh? Wait, Ace...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: He's gone. Where's the fire?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ace probably still has work to finish.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: R-Right, Blaze! Have you eaten yet? The cafeteria made your favorite stir-fry today. Would you like to go together?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Also, I borrowed the CD you said you liked from Operator Elysium... Want to listen to it together?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whoa, you mean his favorite? Of course!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But... What's the matter, little rabbit? You seem way too enthusiastic today.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hmm... Is it obvious?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Super obvious!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um, sorry, Blaze... I overheard your conversation with Ace...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hm? Oh...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Don't worry so much about that. Smile. Yep, that's right. Turn the frown upside down. There's no need to apologize. I wasn't trying to hide anything anyway.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well, you heard it yourself. I have a good idea why Dr. Kal'tsit wants to see me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If my hunch is correct, you probably know what this is about, right, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I knew it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Were you trying to cheer me up because you were worried it was giving me too much stress? You're so cute, Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please stop saying that...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay, I'll knock it off. Let's get serious.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm really not that confident in myself, and I really think I have a ways to go, too.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Look, the thing is... if I didn't have the weapon that Mechanist designed, I don't think I could've been any help to my team at all.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I mean it, Amiya. Can I really do it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When I heard you ask Ace just now, I thought I had to tell you how I feel...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm listening, Amiya. I always listen to what you have to say.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you working hard because you're trying to earn some kind of title, Blaze?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right? Blaze, you're putting in so much work not to become something. It's actually the opposite. It's because you are who you are that we think you are the right person for the job...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And everyone trusts you already, don't they?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone who came back from the mission in Siracusa told me this—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'It's all thanks to Blaze.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'If it wasn't for her cutting open that wall, we couldn't have finished the mission.'

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: T-That doesn't say anything about me. It's all thanks to what Mechanist gave me...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But no one else could've used such massive equipment as well as you did.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If it wasn't for you, Ace might've gone with a safer plan.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: See? Everyone trusts you, and you are an inseparable part of the team now. This is the most important thing.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm just trying to say—We aren't giving you the title so that you can take the job.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's your own actions that decided all of this, Blaze. You chose to become a certain kind of person, and you have chosen to take on that responsibility.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If all we wanted was combat capability, we could've asked somebody else. If we wanted a big pile of muscle, we didn't have to ask you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Does that mean what I think it means?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Uh, no, probably not...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I-I'm just trying to say that strength isn't the only thing Rhodes Island is looking for!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You should believe in yourself, Blaze, and believe in us!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you've made your decision, I'm ready to go with you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay, okay... Sheesh, my whole face is going red.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Enough, little rabbit. I know what you're trying to say.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're right. Jeez, you really have a way with words.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ehehe...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay, it's almost time. I gotta pull it together and go to my meeting now.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I've never once thought of running away, you know?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, I-I'll come with you!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Great! Let's take a relaxing walk together. How come you look like you're more nervous than I am?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: D-Do I...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yep. Smile! That frown ruins your cute little face.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nn... hehe.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There we go.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Trust me. I won't disappoint you.
Blaze walks down the long, dim hallway. The light above her head gently sways as the landship continues its march forward, causing her shadow on the ground to waver side to side as well.
Amiya has accompanied her on the entire journey to this door.
Then she swings it open.
The staircase leading down is long and dark, as though truly bottomless. Blaze takes a deep breath and begins her descent, leaving Amiya behind.
She must walk the rest of the way by herself.
At the bottom of the staircase, Blaze can make out a long table in a room that structurally seems cold as ice, with a warm, yellow light casting upon its steel beams.
A few familiar figures, some less so, stand under the lamplight.
From the shadows, a person that Blaze is all too familiar with steps forward, just as she expected her to.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Here you are.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I expected this to be a formal event, but this is quite the party...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Both Ace and Mechanist. Uh... and this is... Logos?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: We're not exchanging cards...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Now I feel so much more relaxed with you guys here. I was pretty scared when I opened the door.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: I recommended you for the job, so of course I'm here.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Ha, I didn't know you were such a coward.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Easy for you to say from that side of the table!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Okay, enough. Let's get down to business, and once this is done, come with me to the workshop. I want to tune that guy for you a little more.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay, I got a present for you, too.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Come on, stop interrupting.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Let's get started.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: To brass tacks, then.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm listening.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island Frontline Combat Squad, Team Ace, Blaze.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: With everyone in this room as witnesses, I need to know how you feel, and what your decision is.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Operator Blaze, will you become one of Rhodes Island's elite operators?
